name: ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic - East New York (Brooklyn)
neighborhoods: Brooklyn clinic (East New York) + citywide mobile/waitlist

phones.label: ASPCA line (844-MY-ASPCA), as listed by the Mayor’s Alliance

notes: Free basic vet care for cats and dogs for East New York residents, supported by the Lewyt Charitable Trust. Only for owners living in zip codes 11207, 11208 or 11212. Bring proof of public assistance: NYCHA, Medicaid, SSI, SSDI, welfare, TANF, or SNAP/WIC. Exams, vaccines, spay/neuter and in-house tests are free for eligible owners. Appointments only: check eligibility and book through the ASPCA's online form. For an emergency, go to an emergency hospital instead. Traps and equipment can be borrowed here (refundable deposit). Not taking on new rescue groups as clients at the moment; that does not affect pet owners.

change_log.note: Rebuilt from the ASPCA's own page for the East New York clinic. Its 'paused' status was wrong: the research said the ASPCA is not taking new rescue-group clients, which the importer read as the clinic being paused for everyone. Its notes had also carried the South Bronx clinic's description, and it claimed all five boroughs.
